hooks.command: payload=$(cat); session_id=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(uv run ruff check . 2>&1); else out=$(ruff check . 2>&1); fi; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; python3 scripts/friction.py record hook_blocked --session-id "$session_id" --payload '{"hook":"commit"}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 2; fi; exit 0

payload=$(cat); session_id=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then out=$(uv run bash -c "bash scripts/validate && ruff check . && python3 -m mypy --strict src/cradle --exclude 'cradle/api/(app|events)\.py\$'" 2>&1); else out=$(bash scripts/validate 2>&1 && ruff check . 2>&1 && python3 -m mypy --strict src/cradle --exclude 'cradle/api/(app|events)\.py$' 2>&1); fi; rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; python3 scripts/friction.py record hook_blocked --session-id "$session_id" --payload '{"hook":"push"}' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; exit 2; fi; exit 0

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; if [ ! -f scripts/worktree_guard.py ]; then gitdir=$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; case "$gitdir" in */worktrees/*) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "scripts/worktree_guard.py is missing from the primary checkout -- refusing until it is restored; nothing else enforces CLAUDE.md's worktree rule." >&2; exit 2; fi; python3 scripts/worktree_guard.py
